title: AerSale® Begins Teardown of 737-800 in the UK, Expanding Regional USM Support for Operators
summary: 3X facility expansion with a new 90,000 sq. ft. Aerostructures MRO operation, replacing AerSale’s former Medley, Florida location
body_markdown:
**MIAMI, FL – November 12, 2026** –


AerSale Corp. (NASDAQ: ASLE), a leading global provider of aftermarket commercial aircraft, engines, and integrated solutions, today announced it has begun the teardown of a Boeing 737-800, manufacturer serial number (MSN) 29132, formerly operated by a major international flag carrier. The teardown is taking place at Air Salvage International (ASI) in the United Kingdom, placing used serviceable material (USM) close to operators and MRO providers across the region.


“Bringing this aircraft into our UK teardown program gives customers in Europe and surrounding markets faster, more convenient access to quality 737NG parts,” said Gary Jones, Chief Operating Officer & Head of Material Sales at AerSale. “Because this airframe was owned and operated by a major international airline, customers can have confidence in the pedigree of the material and the strength of the documentation behind it.”


**Regional availability**


Disassembling the aircraft in the UK allows AerSale to support operators throughout Europe and the Middle East with shorter lead times and simpler logistics for AOG and planned maintenance requirements.


****


**Quality and traceability**
As a former aircraft of a major European international airline, the airframe’s operating and maintenance history was managed under a major carrier’s oversight, supporting strong back-to-birth traceability for removed components.


****


**Available material**
Parts from the 737-800 will be available through AerSale’s USM business segment, with landing gear, flight controls, avionics, interiors, APU, and various components expected to become available beginning November. Customers can request availability and quotes at sales@aersale.com.


**About AerSale**


AerSale (NASDAQ: ASLE) is a global provider of aviation after-market products and services, supporting the full life cycle of commercial aircraft. The company serves operators of Boeing, Airbus and Bombardier aircraft through a comprehensive portfolio of airframe and component maintenance, used serviceable material (USM), asset leasing and trading, and engineered solutions. AerSale helps airlines, lessors and other aviation stakeholders extend aircraft service life, optimize asset value and maintain economical operations through technical expertise, innovated solutions and a commitment to quality and reliability.


**About Air Salvage International (ASI)**


Air Salvage International (ASI) is one of the world’s largest privately owned aircraft disassembly and aviation asset management companies, and a sector leader whose pioneering work has transformed global end-of-life aircraft practices for almost three decades. The company, based at Cotswold Airport, enables airlines, lessors, component traders to maximise asset value while reducing environmental impact across the global aviation supply chain.
